notes: - **`get_premium_panel`** — the batch cross-section of substantiated value, price and premium that the screener and band machinery read, so nothing has to build models inline (evaluating a premium live across 500 names would mean 500 model builds per query). **Coverage is the headline, not a footnote**: names without a model are excluded *and counted*, never treated as failing a filter, because a panel that silently drops two thirds of its universe is worse than one that refuses. - **`seed_premium_history`** — solves the sequencing problem that would have made premium bands useless.
